entries.documented_meaning: Fault with the engine lubrication system.
entries.documented_instruction: (1) Stop the vehicle as soon as it is safe to do so and switch off the ignition. (2) Contact a PEUGEOT dealer or a qualified workshop.

entries.documented_meaning: Fault in the emissions control system. The warning lamp should go off when the engine is started.
entries.documented_instruction: Go to a PEUGEOT dealer or a qualified workshop without delay.

entries.documented_meaning: Fault in the engine management system. Risk of catalytic-converter destruction.
entries.documented_instruction: Contact a PEUGEOT dealer or a qualified workshop.

entries.symbol_descriptor: Illuminates for approximately 30 seconds when starting
entries.documented_meaning: AdBlue® driving-range warning: 1,500–500 miles (2,400–800 km) of range remaining.

entries.audible_signal: Yes (further detail not specified in the supplied source)
entries.documented_meaning: AdBlue® driving-range warning: 500–62 miles (800–100 km) of range remaining.
entries.documented_instruction: Promptly top up AdBlue®, or go to a PEUGEOT dealer or a qualified workshop.

entries.displayed_message: Driving-range message: less than 62 miles (100 km) remaining
entries.audible_signal: Yes (further detail not specified in the supplied source)
entries.documented_meaning: Risk that engine starting will be prevented.
entries.documented_instruction: Top up AdBlue® to avoid engine starting being prevented, or go to a PEUGEOT dealer or a qualified workshop.

entries.displayed_message: Message indicating that starting is prevented (exact wording not specified in the supplied source for this state)
entries.audible_signal: Yes (further detail not specified in the supplied source)
entries.documented_meaning: AdBlue® tank empty. The legally required engine immobiliser prevents engine starting.
entries.documented_instruction: Top up AdBlue® (at least 5 litres) or contact a PEUGEOT dealer or a qualified workshop.

entries.documented_meaning: Documented only as part of the confirmed SCR emissions-control-system malfunction combination (see combined_with_entry_ids); the supplied source gives this lamp no independent standalone meaning.

entries.audible_signal: Yes (further detail not specified in the supplied source)
entries.documented_meaning: SCR emissions-control-system malfunction detected. An audible signal and a display message are documented for this state; the supplied source does not include the exact message wording for this initial phase. The alert disappears if exhaust emissions return to normal.

entries.manufacturer_designation: SCR emissions control system (BlueHDi) -- confirmed malfunction
entries.symbol_descriptor: Combination: AdBlue® warning lamp flashing, together with the Service warning lamp and Engine self-diagnostics warning lamp both fixed
entries.displayed_message: Emissions control fault: starting prevented in X miles (kms)
entries.documented_meaning: Confirmed SCR emissions-control-system malfunction, reached after the initial fault indication has remained permanently displayed for 31 miles / 50 km of driving. Up to 685 miles / 1,100 km may remain before engine immobilisation, counting down from that point.
entries.documented_instruction: Have the vehicle checked by a PEUGEOT dealer or qualified workshop without delay to avoid starting being prevented.

entries.manufacturer_designation: SCR emissions control system (BlueHDi) -- starting prevented
entries.documented_instruction: Contact a PEUGEOT dealer or a qualified workshop.
